name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 24 times in 8 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
